notes: Fixed the lobby chat overlay showing on top of the patch notes panel
Fixed large score counters like 1210/1210 so they fit on screen
Fixed multi-word Pokémon guesses such as Iron Bundle, including space-less input like ironbundle
Fixed co-op quiz state restoration after leaving a quiz, playing another quiz, and returning
Fixed large co-op quiz loading and state sync issues that could leave clients missing guesses or the finished panel
Fixed co-op lobbies staying open when the host closes the game with Alt+F4
Fixed Full Quiz and type quiz tile sizing so hidden white squares stay visible
Improved type quiz layouts with two columns and more stable column resizing
Reveal type and Reveal shadow now scroll to the revealed Pokémon
Shadow-revealed Pokémon can now be enlarged with the Ctrl preview
